facts.fact: Wheat MSP for RMS 2027-28 is Rs 2,610 per quintal
The wheat MSP rose by Rs 25 per quintal
facts.quote: For Lentil (Masur), barley, gram, and wheat, there is an increase of Rs.390 per quintal, Rs.136 per quintal, Rs.83 per quintal and Rs.25 per quintal respectively.

facts.fact: The previous wheat MSP (RMS 2026-27) was Rs 2,585 per quintal
facts.quote: S. No. Crops MSP RMS 2027-28 Cost* of Production RMS 2027-28 Margin over cost (in percent) MSP RMS 2026-27 Increase in MSP (Absolute) 1 Wheat 2610 1264 106 2585 25

facts.fact: The expected margin over the all-India weighted average cost of production is 106% for wheat
facts.quote: The expected margin over All-India weighted average cost of production is 106 percent for wheat

facts.fact: Rapeseed & Mustard MSP rose by Rs 413 per quintal, more than wheat's Rs 25
facts.quote: The absolute highest increase in MSP has been announced for Safflower at Rs.675 per quintal followed by Rapeseed & Mustard at Rs.413 per quintal.
facts.note: The comparison is derived: Rs 413 here against wheat's Rs 25 in the next fact's quote.

facts.fact: The decision is the CCEA's, released by PIB on 30 Sep 2026
facts.quote: Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA) Cabinet approves Minimum Support Prices (MSP) for Rabi Crops for Marketing Season 2027-28 Posted On: 30 SEP 2026 3:06PM by PIB Delhi

summary: PIB 30 Sep 2026 CCEA release confirms wheat MSP Rs 2,610 (+Rs 25 from Rs 2,585), 106% margin, rapeseed & mustard +Rs 413.
